semantics: Preserve every R10V native replay, original launch/retention check and finite measurement predicate. R10W changes campaign source, authority, seed, worker and report-context bindings only; its qualified integration and fresh route ghost remain required.
campaign_context: Exactly one r10w_campaign context binds original campaign claim, child and parent attempts, nonce, role, source, candidate, seed label/digest and prefix phase; a separately bound r10w_host context owns the durable lifecycle.
original_evidence: Retain and cross-check original stdout marker, worker report, full child envelope, termination and engine health, exact launch relationship, full native replay, final audit and original supervisor/host publications. No repair or substituted terminal receipt.
result: For every declared cell, record execution validity separately from all finite-task predicates. Require six valid positives for held-out acceptance; retain negative, invalid, incomplete and unopened cells and original reasons.
branch_rule: Record the actual upright, partial or prone entry and direct or bounded-hold handoff. The unchanged task governs allowed handoffs. The phase245 development ghost additionally requires upright bounded hold.
